backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for a cloud storage backend that manages file metadata, blob storage, folders, sharing, trash, notifications, activity logs, and user profiles with access control and storage quota enforcement.
feature_evidence.json: JSON report mapping feature IDs and titles (primarily pagination-related features) to their implementing source files, component dependencies, and test IDs with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON dictionary providing one-to-two sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference document for the project's frontend architecture.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS stylesheet defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark color themes including background, foreground, sidebar, chart, and semantic UI tokens.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point for the React app titled 'CloudStorage' that mounts the app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with all application routes, handles Internet Identity authentication state, conditionally renders login or profile setup screens, and wraps the app in theme and recent-uploads providers.
frontend/src/components/ActivityFeed.tsx: Card component that fetches and displays a scrollable list of recent file activities (upload, download, delete) with icons, file names, and relative timestamps, showing an empty state when no activities exist.
frontend/src/components/CreateFolderDial: Modal dialog component for creating a new folder or subfolder, with a name input, validation, and toast notifications for success or failure using the useCreateFolder mutation hook.
frontend/src/components/DeleteConfirmati: An alert dialog for permanently deleting selected trash items, showing file count, total size, and an optional secure wipe checkbox before confirming deletion.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFileDialog: A dialog for moving a single file to trash, allowing the user to select a retention period (30, 60, or 90 days) before confirming.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFolderConf: An alert dialog for permanently deleting one or more folders from trash, warning that all contained files and subfolders will also be irreversibly deleted.
frontend/src/components/DeleteFolderToTr: A dialog for moving a folder and all its contents to trash, letting the user choose a retention period (30, 60, or 90 days) via radio buttons before confirming.
frontend/src/components/FileFilterDropdo: A dropdown filter panel for files supporting filtering by name, file type, date range, and size range, with a badge showing the count of active filters and a clear-all option.
frontend/src/components/FileList.tsx: The main file and folder listing component that integrates search, filtering, sorting, and pagination, and supports actions like preview, delete-to-trash, move, rename, favorite, and drag-and-drop into folders.
frontend/src/components/FilePreview.tsx: A full-screen modal component that previews files (images, videos, PDFs, text) by generating blob URLs or decoding text content, with a download button and file metadata display.
A debounced search input component with a clear button for filtering files by name or type.
frontend/src/components/FileSortDropdown: A dropdown menu component for sorting files by name, date, size, or type, displaying the current sort field and direction with icons.
frontend/src/components/FileToolbar.tsx: A composite toolbar component combining search, filter, sort, and grid/list view toggle controls for the file browser.
frontend/src/components/FileUpload.tsx: A drag-and-drop file upload component that supports multiple files, shows selected files before upload, and tracks recent uploads via context after successful submission.
frontend/src/components/FolderBreadcrumb: A breadcrumb navigation component that shows the current folder path with a Home button and navigates between folders.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: The sticky top navigation header with app branding, search, notification bell with unread badge, dark/light theme toggle, and a user avatar dropdown with logout.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: The root layout component that composes the Header, a toggleable Sidebar, and a main content area rendered via React Router's Outlet.
frontend/src/components/MoveFolderDialog: Dialog component for moving a folder to a new destination, filtering out the folder's own descendants as invalid targets and showing a confirmation step before executing the move via the `useMoveFolder` hook.
frontend/src/components/MoveToFolderDial: Dialog component for moving one or more files to a selected folder, listing available folders via radio buttons and calling `useMoveFilesToFolder` on confirmation.
frontend/src/components/Notifications.ts: Displays a list of user notifications (storage warnings, share alerts, activity alerts, system announcements) with unread count badge and a mark-as-read action per notification.
frontend/src/components/PaginationContro: Reusable pagination UI component that renders page navigation buttons, ellipsis for large page counts, an items-per-page selector, and a current range summary.
frontend/src/components/PinnedFiles.tsx: Displays a horizontally scrollable list of the user's favorited/pinned files with preview and download action buttons, using the `useGetFavorites` hook.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Onboarding form that collects a new user's name and email and saves the profile via `useSaveCallerUserProfile`, shown before the main app is accessible.
frontend/src/components/QuickActions.tsx: Renders three quick-action buttons (Upload Files, New Folder, Create Text Document) that trigger file uploads, folder creation dialog, or blank text file creation, with toast notifications and recent-uploads tracking.
frontend/src/components/RecentActivityCa: Displays a scrollable card of recent file activities (upload, delete, restore, permanent delete) fetched via a query hook, with appropriate icons, colors, and loading/empty states.
frontend/src/components/RenameFolderDial: A modal dialog that allows users to rename an existing folder, validating the new name and calling the renameFolder mutation with success/error toast feedback.
frontend/src/components/RestoreDialog.ts: A modal dialog for restoring trashed files or folders, letting users choose between restoring to the original location or a custom path, then invoking the provided onRestore callback.
frontend/src/components/SharedByMe.tsx: Lists files the current user has shared with others, supporting search and pagination, and allows revoking individual shares via the revokeShare mutation.
frontend/src/components/SharedWithMe.tsx: Displays files shared with the current user with search and pagination, and provides preview and download actions while recording file access via a mutation.
frontend/src/components/Sidebar.tsx: Renders a collapsible sidebar with navigation menu items (Home, My Files, Shared, Recent, Trash, Settings, and conditionally Admin for admin users) and a storage quota indicator at the bottom.
frontend/src/components/SmartSuggestions: Displays AI-powered file suggestions based on access history in a horizontally scrollable card list, with preview and download actions that also record file access.
Shows a detailed storage usage card with a color-coded progress bar, used/total/available byte counts, and percentage used, fetched via the storage quota query.
frontend/src/components/StorageQuotaIndi: Compact sidebar storage indicator showing used vs. total MB with a color-coded progress bar (green/yellow/red) and available space text.
frontend/src/components/TrashFilters.tsx: Provides filter controls (search, file type, owner, date range, original path) for the trash view, applying client-side filtering and notifying the parent of owner filter changes for backend queries.
frontend/src/components/TrashStorageIndi: Displays a card showing how much storage is consumed by trashed files as a size and percentage of the user's total quota.
frontend/src/components/UserStorageManag: Admin component that lists all users' storage usage in a table with progress bars and allows editing individual user storage quotas via a dialog.
frontend/src/contexts/RecentUploadsConte: React context that tracks recently uploaded files in local state, exposing methods to add and clear uploads for use throughout the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an Internet Computer actor using React Query, returning either an authenticated or anonymous actor based on the current identity, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFileFilters.ts: Provides state and logic for filtering a list of FileMetadata by name, type, date range, and size range, with helpers to clear filters and count active ones.
frontend/src/hooks/useFileSearch.ts: Provides a search query state and a memoized function to filter FileMetadata by file name or extension.
frontend/src/hooks/useFileSorting.ts: Manages sort state (field and order) and provides a memoized function to sort FileMetadata arrays by name, date, size, or type.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login, logout, identity, and status state to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/usePagination.ts: Generic pagination hook that tracks current page and items-per-page state and provides a function to slice any data array to the current page.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes all React Query hooks for backend interactions including user profiles, roles, file uploads, and other canister operations, using the actor from useActor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS base imports and CSS custom properties for light and dark theme design tokens (colors, radius, etc.).
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a cn utility function that merges Tailwind CSS class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin-only dashboard page that displays summary stat cards, a UserStorageManager, and an ActivityFeed, with access control based on the caller's user role.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main file management page that lets users browse folders, upload files, and create folders, with breadcrumb navigation and view toggling between file list and upload views.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing dashboard page displaying a grid layout with storage overview, quick actions, pinned files, recent activity, shared files, notifications, and smart suggestions.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Authentication page that presents app features and a sign-in button using Internet Identity for blockchain-based cloud storage access.
frontend/src/pages/Recent.tsx: Page displaying recently uploaded files from the current session with search, filter, sort, pagination, preview, download, and favorite toggle functionality.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Settings page allowing users to view account info, configure trash retention period, and manage theme preferences (light/dark/system).
frontend/src/pages/Shared.tsx: Shared files page with two tabs showing files shared with the current user and files the user has shared with others.
frontend/src/pages/Trash.tsx: Trash management page that lists deleted files and folders with sorting, filtering, bulk selection, restore, and permanent delete operations, including admin owner filtering support.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with helpers to persist, retrieve, and clear those values via sessionStorage and history.replaceState.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining dark mode, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, border radius variables, accordion keyframe animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Project state manifest for the CloudStorage file manager app (draft v33), tracking five existing pagination features (My Files, Shared, Trash, Recent) and one pending action request to add full pagination across all sections.
